title: AS2: Date and Math class method tests
description: Add AS2 compiler tests for Date and Math built-in class usage. Create packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/datemath.test.ts: new Date() compiles; new Date(2024,1,1) compiles; Date.now() compiles; Math.round(x) compiles; Math.floor(x) compiles; Math.random() compiles; Math.PI compiles; Math.sqrt(x) compiles; Math.max(a,b) compiles. All should compile without error via the existing ActionNew/ActionCallMethod paths. Also test: parseInt(), parseFloat(), isNaN(), isFinite() compile correctly.
